import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate the CSV to one daily temperature per city.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
daily = df.groupby(['date', 'city'], as_index=False)['temp_c'].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for city in ['London', 'Cairo']:
    city_data = daily[daily['city'] == city].sort_values('date')
    ax.plot(city_data['date'], city_data['temp_c'], marker='o', label=city)

ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Daily Temperature: London and Cairo')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.autofmt_xdate()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
